svg.title: Conditional 36-month break-even initial investment at monthly token workloads of 24B input/6B output, 48B input/12B output and 64B input/16B output, where B means one billion tokens. The horizontal axis scales a paired SLO-qualified capacity: 1x is 32,000 input tokens/second plus 8,000 output tokens/second, attained together for the same workload; both rates scale by the same multiplier from 0x to 2.5x. At 1x the limits are approximately RMB 0.824m, 1.457m and 1.766m. The amber line is the assumed RMB 1.6m purchase budget. Costs, 10 percent annual discount and fixed RMB 240,000 terminal resale stay constant. The base curve plateaus when online demand is served. This is not a hardware ranking or performance benchmark.
